fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting focused on Florida and Miami-area politics and public policy, including opposition to a proposed state sales tax and commentary on the Hoover Commission’s recommendations for reorganizing government. Coverage discusses Miami municipal affairs and civil service disputes, gambling and slot machines in Florida, and public safety concerns about easy access to firearms. Additional items include notes on Jackson Memorial Hospital conditions and tourism promotion featuring Delta Air Lines advertising for Miami vacations.
